changes.change: Allow blank screen.name only when notes explicitly contain 'title_status: absent'. Module names remain mandatory.
Generic 404 navigation destinations are documented in a separate anomaly log and are not inserted as functional reference screens; therefore they are not automatic FNs.

Operationally define screen as a stable route-addressable functional view. Stable menu-exposed parameter variants remain separate reference rows when they change functional context, even if they reuse one Angular component.

trigger: Independent Expert A RQ1 inspection, before reference freeze and before FORMAL crawler output, exposed representational edge cases in the real ERP: reachable screens without a visible page title, dead navigation destinations returning the generic 404 page, and stable menu routes that reuse one frontend component with different functional parameters.
